note: H, the Heart (art plan batch H), 2026-10-30. create_map_object in style matching never drew a building in batch C's three tests (see c_buildings.json _map_object_tests), so the Heart went straight to its STYLE.md fallback: one create_1_direction_object job at size 112 (10 generations, 4 candidates, palette = the 46 Apollo hexes, palette_name Apollo, view top-down, no style images), PixelLab review object 02ecb324-c171-4b31-864f-d7a366778f4f. All 4 frames are kept untouched in art/raw/h/candidates/frame_<i>.png; every frame came back 100% Apollo, no partial alpha, filling the whole 112 x 112. The pick was promoted with select_object_frames (tag h_heart) and saved as art/raw/h/b_heart_dormant.png, byte-identical to frame 1. b_heart (awake) is a free recolour of that same sprite in pixelart_workbench (art/edit/h/b_heart.workbench.json), replayable offline with 'node scripts/art/recolor.ts art/edit/h/edits.json' (checked pixel for pixel against the workbench download). Anchor fields (art plan issue 11; not read by art:build), [x, y, w, h] in final 112 x 112 sprite pixels (the art fills the canvas, so final = raw): _core = the core gem, _light = the awake light spot (the dormant Heart has none, like the code-drawn one).
_prompt: description: enormous ancient machine sprite in high top-down 3/4 view, flat top and a thin south face, filling the whole frame, selective dark outline, lit from upper left, no ground shadow. Slots 0 and 2: 'the dormant Heart of the mountain, an enormous round ancient alien engine in high top-down 3/4 view, seen from above: concentric carved grey-green stone gear rings with dark green joints, dark navy glass conduits radiating outward to the edges, a dim dark blue glass core in the center, unlit, thin stone south face'. Slots 1 and 3: 'enormous ancient alien engine core in high top-down 3/4 view, seen from above: a huge round machine of stacked grey-green stone rings with carved gear teeth, four thick dark navy glass pipes running out to the four edges, a big unlit deep blue crystal core in the middle, dark green moss in the joints, thin stone south face'.
_why: Frame 1 is the only candidate whose whole gear ring sits inside the canvas (teeth all round, a darker band under the teeth for its thickness), with a faceted #253a5e / #3c5e8b gem core and four #172038 glass conduits running out to the corners. Its glass colours are used nowhere in the stone, so the awake recolour is two exact colour maps that touch nothing else.

_rejected.0: eight dark spokes over carved rings, but the outer ring is cut flat by the left and top canvas edges.
_rejected.2: rings cut by the left edge, and one conduit kinks off to the top edge.
_rejected.3: a square-in-square star frame over the gear plus six curling corner pipes: the busiest of the four, and the gear is cut by the left edge.
